title: YourMondayMotivator: Life is full of moments ...
html: I'm sure you will agree that Life is full of moments, not all of them good. But good by whose standard? Yours? Yours is distorted by years of unfufilled dreams and heavy duty advertising In the film Up in the Air Ryan Bingham (George Clooney)is a motivational speaker who isn't that motivating. But, he does have one line that prompts a wayward groom to marry his niece.Ryan Bingham: If you think about it, your favorite memories, the most important moments in your life... were you alone? Life's better with company. That's a great line. One that makes up for the terrible motivational speaking on a heavy backpack. Although his idea that moving is living is a good one. For some people Easter isn't just a holiday with chocolate. It's a very significant time and one to be spent with company. A time of renewal.A time to create some good moments. Get off your phone or from in front of your computer screen now and go and make them. Have a great day.
